chapter: Studio recordings of the late twenties and thirties
title: Playing with Gene Krupa
summary: Kline recounts Krupa replacing him on a Hotsy Totsy Gang date; Morehouse describes playing in the same group as Krupa without working out parts.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Right, okay. One session, I don't know if you were around or not, but one session you were playing with Irving Mills and his Hotsy Totsy Gang, you were replaced by another young drummer for one recording session, a fellow named Gene Krupa.
We all know what happened to him. Did you ever play with Gene Krupa?
How do you play with Gene Krupa? What is it like playing with Gene Krupa?
Well first you have to get the set of everything that's to be played, you know.
And then when you get that set, you line them up.
When you played with Gene Krupa, did you play the same drums? I mean did you always play? Did you ever change?
I played snare drum and everything.
Uh huh. Did one of you have...did you have to work out something in advance that one of you played a certain beat?
